question: Gemini 4's idea 2 (after e560/e568): do the wrong capital answers hide capitals the model knew, recoverable by peeling the function-word words off the final-block running total, beyond Gemini's own kill baselines (masking the function words in the logits; subtracting the mean prompt state)?
design: e560's 160 prompts 'The capital of X is', right = next token is the capital's first token; function words = wikitext-2 train's 200 most frequent tokens + ' located', ' situated', ' home', minus capitals' first tokens; interventions none / prompt mean subtracted (literal and to the corpus mean) / function-pushing words peeled (native and rotated) / words recurring in half the supports peeled / a random peel of as many non-function words, each raw and masked; native union vs masked logits at the same size. Pythia-410m (e560's model) and Qwen2.5-0.5B.
smoke: Pythia-160m on 48 capitals: accuracy 0, 47 of 48 wrong answers are function words; masking alone recovers 0, the function-word peel 0 (with or without the mask), the literal prompt-mean subtraction 10 (11 with the mask), the corpus-mean variant 0 (2), the recurring peel+mask 2.
note_on_e568: e568's dominant row (block 17 neuron 3002) is top in 0.0125 of real-country capital prompts (0.90 is on invented countries) and zeroing it changes the top-1 answer in 0 of them, so the mechanism Gemini cites (a function-word row outvoting the fact) is not supported going in.

S1.text: masking the function words in the logits alone recovers the capital on 30 percent or more of the hedge-wrong prompts

S2.text: peeling the function-pushing words, with the mask, recovers at least three more wrong answers than the mask alone

S3.text: the function-word peel without the mask recovers more wrong answers than the mask alone

S4.text: peeling the words recurring across prompts, with the mask, recovers more wrong answers than the literal prompt-mean subtraction with the mask

S5.text: the native function-word peel with the mask recovers more wrong answers than the rotated-dictionary peel with the mask

S6.text: the function-word peel with the mask keeps 90 percent or more of the right answers

status: fixed before the full runs; smokes on Pythia-160m (plumbing; seen before these were fixed, and reflected in the guesses)
